startup.failed.detail: Nothing was changed. Check the session log, then start TapeBox again.

settings.loadFailed: Settings could not be loaded. No values have been assumed; try again.

settings.moveMessage.one: This will move {count} tape to the new folder. The move must finish completely before the new folder is saved.
settings.moveMessage.other: This will move {count} tapes to the new folder. The move must finish completely before the new folder is saved.

settings.uiFontHint: Comma-separated font families; the first one your system has is used. Blank uses the built-in default.
settings.autostartHint: Newly added tapes start downloading immediately. Off = added as paused.
settings.libraryFolderHint: Where tapes are saved. Changing this moves your existing tapes to the new folder. Not available while downloads, imports, renames or exports are running.
settings.autoplayHint: Start playback automatically when a downloaded tape is opened.
settings.playSoundHint: Play video audio. When off, every video is muted and the volume control can't unmute it.
settings.keepAwake: Keep the computer awake while playing
settings.keepAwakeHint: Hold a system wake lock while a tape is playing, so the screen won't dim and the computer won't sleep mid-watch. Released as soon as playback stops.
settings.defaultExportHint: Where Export copies a tape's files. Blank means the export dialog asks each time.
settings.deleteAfterExportHint: After copying a tape's files out, remove it from TapeBox (respecting the Trash setting below). Off = keep the copy in the library too.
settings.confirmRemoveHint: Ask for confirmation before a tape is removed.
settings.trashOnRemoveHint: Removed tapes go to the OS Trash (recoverable). Off = deleted permanently.
settings.aiIntro: Used to suggest a file slug from each tape's title. TapeBox currently supports OpenAI-compatible providers only.
settings.apiKeyWillClear: Key will be cleared on save.
settings.ytdlpIntro: TapeBox's own flags (output, info json) always win on conflict.
settings.globalArgsHint: One flag per line (or space-separated). Quote any value that contains spaces. Backslashes are literal — not line-continuations — so Windows paths work as written.
settings.noProfiles: No site profiles yet. Add one to apply extra yt-dlp flags only to URLs that match a pattern — handy for a site that needs a specific header or format.
